\begin{document}
The level couples to the left and right leads with tunneling rates $\Gamma_{L,R}>0$. The
effective hopping between the leads through the level is set by the geometric mean of the rates,
\begin{equation}
\sqrt{\Gamma_L\Gamma_R} = \sqrt{\Gamma_L}\,\sqrt{\Gamma_R} .
\label{eq:geo}
\end{equation}
